Lane f041: implemented as local commit 866c176f502c (59 files, +651/-1013) on origin/main 441ca94f4a8.

AC2 grep A (removed verbs as quoted literals over tests scripts), PRE-edit: 67 hits in 23 files. This matches the fourth-review inventory: probe_rebar.py 16, retarget_jira_project.py, gen_cli_reference.py, ticket-cli-baseline.json, the 16 CI-run test files, the two removed-set tests, and the 4 library-name allowlist rows.
AC2 grep A, POST-edit: 4 hits, all allowlisted library rows:
tests/interfaces/facades/test_surface.py:136:        "untag",
tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json:1634:    "untag": {
tests/unit/mcp_library_parity_manifest.json:855:      "library_symbol": "untag",
tests/unit/test_cross_session_lib.py:260:    ("untag", _setup_tagged, lambda r, t: rebar.untag(t, "x", repo_root=str(r))),

AC2 grep B (_cmd_session_logs|list_descendants_cli|file_impact_cli|verify_commands_cli|exists_cli|format_cli over tests): PRE 4 hits (test_reads_cli_uninitialized_store.py x2, test_cli_registry_dispatch.py x2); POST 0 hits.

Checked: the dispatch test is parametrized from _REMOVED_SPELLINGS (16 rows, exit 2 + hint + route_for None). main() end to end: resolve <id> and --display=alias exit 0; check / --ac / --clarity reach 0/1; list --limit newest-2, all, 0 and x exit 2. retarget_jira_project.py --strip-tags against a temp store stripped dso-id:jira-ABC-1 and kept the other tag. probe_rebar.py: 142 passed, 0 failed. mcp_library_parity_manifest.json diff clean. help, reference and other generators --check 0. Complexity new=0 increased=0 (_cmd_list 16 under its 18 ceiling, _cmd_show 12); mechanism increased=0. Lint and typecheck green.

Count note: the story title says twelve verbs, but the description's own list, the epic's mapping table and the registry all have eleven (exists, format, check-ac, clarity-check, quality-check, tag, untag, get-file-impact, get-verify-commands, list-descendants, session-logs). The registry therefore has 11 new + 5 historical = 16 removed spellings. Behaviour change for library/MCP callers of recent_session_logs: ties on created_at now break by ticket_id ascending (sort_states); this belongs in the release note (docs story).
